implementation_policy: libuipc 0.0.29 CUDA IPC solve (case-isolated wheel in .runtime/curtain_doraemon_drape/uipc_029, Python 3.10 with numpy/scipy/trimesh) of a 0.92 m x 0.50 m pleated cotton-linen curtain, already released at the first frame and modelled as a strain-limiting Baraff-Witkin thin shell with discrete shell bending, falling onto a dynamic 0.75 kg affine-body porcelain vase (object id figurine; hollow open-mouth collider built from the CC0 scan by tools/prepare_vase.py) standing on a fixed desk by a window; momentum-preserving internal damping and passive air drag enter as external forces, nothing is authored or filtered (physics/simulate.py, physics/cloth_dissipation.py). The four whole-clip edits change only their DSL-bound parameter (physics/vocab.py); the timed edit friction_x0_1_at_frame_8 continues the accepted source solve from the exact source state of frame 8 with the edited friction (physics/simulate.py --source-cache). appearance/render.py replays the native curtain vertices through an exact MDD cache and the native affine transforms into a closed window-side room lit only by HDRI daylight through the window (Cycles, fixed camera, motion blur, OIDN). tools/finalize_remote.py encodes the video and writes masks, camera calibration and native GT sidecars; tools/build_suite.py and tools/standardize_case.py package the native delivery (scene_manifest.json data.accepted_delivery); tools/publish_suite.py and tools/export_ground_truth.py assemble the PCVE suite named in canonical_suites. Solves and renders run on a Linux host on the GPU given by --gpu-uuid, or on an idle GPU picked by tools/worker_run.py. Effective material parameters, not fitted to a measured product.
